newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's SET index breaks through 600-pt level.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's SET index breaks through 600-pt level.

text.p: Thailand's SET index broke through the key psychological level of 600 late on Friday morning as economic and currency concerns saw continued sales of bank and finance stocks by foreign investors, traders said.
The SET Index dropped 14.07 points, or 2.29 percent, to 599.97 by 0429 GMT. The SET 50 fell 01.10 points, or 2.44 percent to 43.29. Turnover was 950 million baht.

Renewed market speculation on Thailand's baht fixing practice after reports of central bank intervention in Singapore this morning and worries about economic fundamentals undermined sentiment, brokers said.

"Foreigners are still selling banks as they have been most of the week. We are checking on the intervention rumours but the currency is a worry again," said a trader at a brokerage firm affiliated with Thai Farmers Bank.
Weak economic growth, export and corporate earnings outlooks, as well as liquidity and asset quality problems in the finance sector weighed on sentiment, analysts said.
Texas Instruments Inc 's attribution of Thai economic problems as a factor for its withdrawal from joint ventures with Alphatec Electronics Plc was a further negative factor, traders said.
Alphatec was limit down 6.50 baht to 59.50, Asia Credit dropped 7.50 to a year low of 76.50, TISCO also hit limit low, falling 5.25 to 48.75.
Banks lost 2.84 percent by 0512 GMT. Bangkok Bank fell three to 160, Thai Farmers four to 107.
The index regained some ground to 602.44 by 0512 GMT.
